ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; estimated >90% coverage of dark pigmentation with high-contrast white localized at edges and specific linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous region covers the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white blobs are clustered at the distal tips; scattered white linear and point-like pixels are distributed sparsely across the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an obtuse internal angle and moderate depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; serration amplitude is significantly higher at the distal tips where pixel clusters create a jagged profile against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a dual-concave sweep meeting at the median notch; leading edges (lower boundary) show a broad, continuous convex curve from the center to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear disruptions; notable parallel diagonal marks on the lower left lobe and several shorter, randomly oriented vertical marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified barnacle colonies at both fluke tips; multiple rake-like linear scars present on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Avian subject (bird) visible in the background water approximately 20-30 pixels above the right fluke tip.
